issue: The published OpenAPI uses a router-style *path suffix and declares a required path parameter named path without an OpenAPI {path} placeholder. A standards-based matcher treats *path literally, so it cannot match the documented concrete application URLs. The node sends /v1/connector/consoles/{id}/network|protect|innerspace/integration/vN/... as described in the provider connector documentation; it must not send the literal *path suffix.
evidence: ConnectorGet description explicitly gives GET /v1/connector/consoles/{id}/network/integration/v1/sites and GET /v1/connector/consoles/{id}/protect/integration/v1/meta/info. All five methods describe forwarding to the application path; POST/PATCH/PUT document JSON object payloads. The same invalid route key remains in the current published v1.0.0 JSON.
